Instead keep the explicit keys but give each a defined fallback from the current state: `activePageId: switchState.activePageId ?? visiblePages[0].id`, `scrollX: switchState.scrollX ?? appState.scrollX`, `scrollY: switchState.scrollY ?? appState.scrollY`, `zoom: switchState.zoom ?? appState.zoom`, `pageViewports: switchState.pageViewports ?? appState.pageViewports`, `selectedElementIds: switchState.selectedElementIds ?? {}`, `selectedGroupIds: switchState.selectedGroupIds ?? {}`, `editingGroupId: switchState.editingGroupId ?? null` (appState is the local AppState already in scope).
